selection.prerequisites: Registered private OpenCL randomness, owned GPU witnesses and device-only PCS consumers; immutable after initialization

reservation.accounting: Additive to owned quotient, witness and randomness allowances, with no overlap credits

implementation: Private registered proof factories select a bounded GPU challenger; public preprocessing and independent verification retain the CPU challenger
Registered transcript families admit two live device states; failed admission occurs before copying; secret storage is scrubbed and freed before a state slot returns
Infallible adapter clone failures retire the family; fallible primitive admission failures leave existing states usable; new attempts are independent
Transcript, grinding and scalar observations use actual session counter and device-event deltas, including completed operations before a later failure; empty observations create no entries
Worker assignments require matching flags, exact fixed bounds/reservations and checked aggregate memory; reject before engine activation, registration imports or private proof-state creation
Resource planning and common worker environment propagate the explicit selection, replacing inherited settings; controller and supervisor interfaces keep the assigned profile

validation.proof_conformance: Full and compact registered proofs in wide release, eight-lane release and debug; three statements with reusable public keys per case. Unchanged registry identity and original upstream CPU PCS/root challenger verification after GPU shutdown; altered public values reject. Owned deterministic proofs retain exact single-thread CPU bytes.
validation.admission_and_reporting: Rust/Python bound and reservation checks, prerequisites, integer overflow, aggregate memory shortfalls, environment overrides, preactivation rejection, state slots, failure retirement and actual stage observations. Strict all-GPU coverage remains false.
validation.cpu_regression: CPU-only build, CPU transcript defaults, registered CPU proving, GPU witness/randomness paths using CPU transcripts, and nine enabled policy/reporting tests pass. Production-strength CPU wallet test remains explicitly ignored.
validation.report_scope: Per-proof transcript observation starts after the initial configuration snapshot; it does not time state creation or that initial copy. Successful later observations/samples/snapshots, grinding and scalar calls are reported.

remaining: GPU setup/registry identity and public-statement arithmetic; complete per-stage observations and strict admission for the supported registered route
Wallet/batch witnesses and maintained Rust/C-ABI proving paths, including quadratic legacy, periodic, nonbinary FRI and general final-polynomial profiles
AMD/Metal qualification and the pending local Mac source commit; no Linux SSH retrieval
Full-size simultaneous memory, cancellation and fresh-attempt retries, followed by sustained delivered transactions/hour across workers and devices
not_established: all proving arithmetic on GPU across the codebase
